defmodule ObserverOwnedFixture.Sentinel do
  def start_link(_opts) do
    parent = self()
    {:ok, pid} = Task.start_link(fn -> init(parent) end)
    receive do {:owned_sentinel_ready, ^pid} -> {:ok, pid} after 5_000 -> {:error, :startup_timeout} end
  end

  defp init(parent) do
    true = Process.register(self(), __MODULE__)
    secrets = Map.new([:state, :dictionary, :queue, :table, :environment], &{&1, Base.encode64(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(48))})
    Process.put(:private_fixture_dictionary, secrets.dictionary)
    Application.put_env(:observer_owned_fixture, :private_fixture_environment, secrets.environment)
    <<random::unsigned-32>> = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(4)
    row_count = 17 + rem(random, 31)
    table = :ets.new(:observer_owned_private, [:set, :private])
    true = :ets.insert(table, Enum.map(1..row_count, &{&1, secrets.table}))
    send(self(), {:private_fixture_payload, secrets.queue})
    send(parent, {:owned_sentinel_ready, self()})
    loop(%{secrets: secrets, table: table, row_count: row_count, counter: random})
  end

  defp loop(state) do
    receive do
      {:attest, from, ref} ->
        {:messages, messages} = Process.info(self(), :messages)
        {:dictionary, dictionary} = Process.info(self(), :dictionary)
        {:message_queue_len, queued} = Process.info(self(), :message_queue_len)
        facts = %{
          pid: self() |> :erlang.pid_to_list() |> to_string(),
          table: inspect(state.table),
          table_size: :ets.info(state.table, :size),
          private_table: :ets.info(state.table, :protection) == :private,
          state_commitment: digest({state.secrets.state, state.counter}),
          table_contents_commitment: digest(Enum.sort(:ets.tab2list(state.table))),
          dictionary_commitment: digest(Enum.sort(dictionary)),
          queued_messages_commitment: digest(messages),
          application_environment_commitment: digest(Application.get_env(:observer_owned_fixture, :private_fixture_environment)),
          queued_messages_count: queued
        }
        send(from, {ref, facts})
        loop(state)

      {:check_private_exclusion, bytes, from, ref} ->
        excluded = Enum.all?(Map.values(state.secrets), fn secret -> :binary.match(bytes, secret) == :nomatch end)
        send(from, {ref, excluded})
        loop(state)
    end
  end

  defp digest(term), do: :crypto.hash(:sha256, :erlang.term_to_binary(term)) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
end

defmodule ObserverOwnedFixture.Inner do
  use Supervisor

  @impl true

    child = %{id: :private_sentinel, start: {ObserverOwnedFixture.Sentinel, :start_link, [[]]}}
    Supervisor.init([child], strategy: :one_for_one)
  end
end

defmodule ObserverOwnedFixture.Application do
  use Application
  @impl true
  def start(_type, _args) do
    Supervisor.start_link([ObserverOwnedFixture.Inner], strategy: :one_for_one, name: ObserverOwnedFixture.Root)
  end
end

defmodule ObserverOwnedFixture.Control do
  def boot do
    {:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:elixir)
    {:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:crypto)
    version = "1.0.0+" <> Base.encode16(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16), case: :lower)
    spec = {:application, :observer_owned_fixture, [description: ~c"Owned actual OTP Observer acceptance application", vsn: String.to_charlist(version), modules: [ObserverOwnedFixture.Sentinel, ObserverOwnedFixture.Inner, ObserverOwnedFixture.Application, __MODULE__], registered: [ObserverOwnedFixture.Sentinel, ObserverOwnedFixture.Inner, ObserverOwnedFixture.Root], applications: [:kernel, :stdlib, :elixir, :crypto], mod: {ObserverOwnedFixture.Application, []}]}
    :ok = :application.load(spec)
    :ok = Application.start(:observer_owned_fixture)
    Code.ensure_loaded!(OhMyJido.Intelligence.Observer)
    %{node: Atom.to_string(node()), os_pid: System.pid(), version: version, collector_beam_sha256: beam_digest(OhMyJido.Intelligence.Observer), collector_path: OhMyJido.Intelligence.Observer |> :code.which() |> to_string(), iterator_supported: function_exported?(:erlang, :processes_iterator, 0), attestation: attest()}
  end

  def attest do
    ref = make_ref()
    send(ObserverOwnedFixture.Sentinel, {:attest, self(), ref})
    receive do {^ref, facts} -> facts after 5_000 -> raise "owned sentinel did not attest" end
  end

  def private_exclusion?(bytes) do
    ref = make_ref()
    send(ObserverOwnedFixture.Sentinel, {:check_private_exclusion, bytes, self(), ref})
    receive do {^ref, excluded} -> excluded after 5_000 -> raise "owned sentinel did not check exclusion" end
  end

  def distribution_attestation do
    %{node: Atom.to_string(node()), cookie_commitment: :crypto.hash(:sha256, :erlang.term_to_binary(Node.get_cookie())) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower), nodes: Enum.sort(Node.list(:connected)), gui_running: Enum.any?(Application.started_applications(), fn {app, _, _} -> app in [:wx, :observer] end)}
  end

  def gone_selectors do
    {pid, monitor} = spawn_monitor(fn -> :ok end)
    receive do {:DOWN, ^monitor, :process, ^pid, :normal} -> :ok after 5_000 -> raise "owned process did not exit" end
    table = :ets.new(:observer_owned_gone, [:private])
    id = inspect(table)
    true = :ets.delete(table)
    %{pid: pid |> :erlang.pid_to_list() |> to_string(), table: id}
  end

  def beam_digest(module) do
    {^module, bytes, _} = :code.get_object_code(module)
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, bytes) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end
end
